recentItems.title: MEP defends Spain over Ceuta crisis: "It's a particular situation"
recentItems.description:
Is the Spanish government responding too little, too late to the Ceuta crisis?

"No, no, I can't agree. It's a particular situation," MEP Juan Fernando López Aguilar tells #EuropeToday as 5,000 of the 80,000 migrants who crossed into Ceuta illegally last month remain in Spain.

recentItems.title: MEP López Aguilar blames Morocco over Ceuta crisis: "It's obvious"
recentItems.description:
"It could not happen without some overlooking of Moroccan authorities."

Juan Fernando López Aguilar tells #EuropeToday that Morocco's involvement in the illegal crossing of 80,000 migrants into Ceuta last month is "obvious."
